name: app.basko/basko
title: Basko
description: Grocery, pharmacy and electronics prices across stores in UZ, KZ, RU, the US and the UK.

tools.name: compare_basket
tools.description: Prices a shopping list at every store in the country: each store's total for the items it sells (with its delivery fee where the store publishes one), the cheapest single store, and the cheapest way to split the list between stores. Items are matched to products by their names, or exactly by productId.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

name.description: The item as a shopper writes it ("milk 1 l", "eggs", "paracetamol 500 mg").

productId.description: A product id from search_products, to compare exactly that product.

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

items.description: A store. Store ids come from find_stores (korzinka, walmart-us, tesco-uk, …).

stores.description: Only these stores (ids from find_stores). Default: every store whose prices are compared.

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Lists the stores Basko covers in a country: their kind, whether their prices are compared now, where the prices come from, delivery fees and links to their sites. With latitude and longitude, also each store's nearest branches with the distance and opening hours (branches are known in Uzbekistan).

branches.description: How many nearest branches per store (1 to 10, default 3).

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

latitude.description: Where to look for branches near (with longitude).

longitude.description: Where to look for branches near (with latitude).

store.description: Only this store. Store ids come from find_stores (korzinka, walmart-us, tesco-uk, …).

tools.name: find_swaps
tools.description: For the items of a shopping list, finds products that do the same job for less: a bigger pack that costs less per kilogram, litre or piece, or another brand of the same kind of product. Each swap says how much cheaper it is per unit and what it saves on the item's quantity.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

name.description: The item as a shopper writes it ("milk 1 l", "eggs", "paracetamol 500 mg").

productId.description: A product id from search_products, to compare exactly that product.

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Lists current deals in a country: products whose price is well below their usual price or clearly lower at one store than at the others, and the biggest price drops of the past week. With store, only that store's deals, plus its own offers page (its weekly offers) when it has one running. Can be narrowed to a product category.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

limit.description: How many products in each list (1 to 20, default 8).

store.description: Only this store's deals. Store ids come from find_stores (korzinka, walmart-us, tesco-uk, …).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns one product's current price at every store in the country that sells it (cheapest first, with delivery and where each price comes from), its lowest price day by day over the last 3 months, and a deal score that compares today's price with its usual price. Product ids come from search_products, get_deals and compare_basket.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches Basko's price database for products sold by stores in one country and returns, for each product, its listings ordered by price (cheapest in-stock first), the number of stores selling it, the size and price per kilogram, litre or piece when known, and links to the listings. Use it to find what a product costs or which store sells it for less. Results are ordered by how well they match the words.

country.description: The country whose stores to read: UZ (Uzbekistan), KZ (Kazakhstan), RU (Russia), US (United States), GB or UK (United Kingdom).

lang.description: Language of texts and amounts in the answer, as a BCP 47 tag (en, ru, uz, uz-Cyrl, kk, es, …). Default: the assistant's locale, else the country's main language.

maxPrice.description: Only listings at or under this price, in the country's currency (dollars, pounds, so'm, tenge, roubles).

query.description: What to look for, in any language ("oat milk", "гречка", "iPhone 17 128GB").

store.description: Only this store's listings. Store ids come from find_stores (korzinka, walmart-us, tesco-uk, …).
